basics.name: Aman Kumar Verma
basics.label: Front-End & Full-Stack Software Engineer | React, Next.js, TypeScript | REST API Integration, UI Performance & Web Security
basics.summary: Software engineer with 1.5 years of hands-on experience building and shipping customer-facing web applications end to end with **React**, **Next.js**, and **TypeScript**. Strong on the front end: turning product requirements and UX designs into performant, responsive, reusable UI components, wiring them to backend services over **REST APIs**, and optimizing for speed by cutting redundant re-renders, batching and caching requests, and tuning Core Web Vitals. Comfortable across the full stack when a feature needs it, with Node.js, Express, and **PostgreSQL**, and security-aware from building a high-risk payments platform (per-merchant keys, row-level security). Also hands-on with Generative AI (LLM integration, RAG, and multi-agent orchestration), a practical edge on modern product teams.

work.name: SellAbroad
highlights: Architected a 7-agent orchestration system that automates merchant onboarding end-to-end (live site analysis, validation, code integration, automated regression QA), with a persistent state layer that resumes on failure instead of losing data mid-run.

Designed and integrated REST/JSON APIs across a merchant-of-record cross-border payments platform, covering third-party integrations with Shopify, payment providers, and shipping carriers, with authentication, pagination, retry, and rate-limit handling.

Replaced static shipping rate tables with real-time carrier-calculated rates at checkout by consuming live carrier web services, improving pricing accuracy and removing manual per-merchant configuration.
Automated cross-border market expansion to 100+ countries with multi-currency pricing, geo-targeting logic, and a BNPL payment matrix, cutting per-merchant setup from hours to minutes.
Modeled relational schemas, indexes, and migrations in PostgreSQL, ran asynchronous job processing on Redis/BullMQ, and documented integration runbooks for repeatable handoff.

work.name: COOX
highlights: Built and shipped production UI features across web and mobile from a shared TypeScript codebase (React with Next.js on web, React Native on mobile), turning designs into reusable, responsive components inside a cross-functional product team.
Improved front-end responsiveness on key user flows by removing redundant React re-renders and consolidating duplicate API calls into batched, cached requests, cutting render and network overhead.
Owned production defect triage through Sentry: traced UI and API failures to root cause across environments, shipped fixes, and eliminated recurring error classes rather than patching symptoms.

projects.name: Portfolio Studio
projects.description: Shipped a portfolio builder end to end on Next.js, TypeScript, and Supabase, with OAuth sign-in, four art-directed, responsive themes behind a shared component registry, a Zod-validated REST export endpoint, and a Postgres schema with migrations and row-level security; the export pipeline inlines CSS, fonts, and images into one self-contained HTML file users can host anywhere.

projects.name: Warden
projects.description: Designed and shipped solo a local-first, read-only dashboard for everything an AI coding agent stores on a machine; hand-built monochrome design system with light and dark themes, a fully client-side demo that renders from a bundled JSON snapshot, on a zero-dependency Node.js core, live on Vercel.

interests.name: building weekend side projects and taking them all the way to a live URL
